cc:Work.dc:title: Student checkpoint scores
cc:Work.dc:description: Eight recorded scores on 2,953 selection pairs, from 67.7% at 0.25 passes to 76.4% at two passes. The selected checkpoint at 1.75 passes scored 76.0%. The vertical axis spans 60% to 80%. This is a selection-score curve, not a training-loss curve.
